power.stlboy.stardust.name: Stardust

power.stlboy.starlight.name: Stellar Hunger
power.stlboy.starlight.description: §7§oMortal food is ash on your tongue. You feed on §b§olight§7§o and §d§oraw energy§7§o: starlight that falls on you, the life you tear from your foes, the shards of the cosmos you crush in your hand.
power.stlboy.stellar_breath.name: Stellar Breath
power.stlboy.stellar_breath.description: §7§oYou gather the light of a thousand suns in your palm, and for three breathless seconds the world holds still. Then the sky §e§oopens§7§o — and every star you trace upon your foe becomes a constellation.
power.stlboy.toolkit.name: Starborn Rituals
power.stlboy.toolkit.description: §7§oSmall habits of a body made of sky: a block set in empty air, a pull on lost things, a memory waiting to be walked, a journal that remembers you.
origin.stlboy.stellarsurfer.name: Stellar Surfer
origin.stlboy.stellarsurfer.description: §7§oBorn from the dust of a dying star, the §b§oStellar Surfer§7§o has forgotten the weight of the ground. It surfs the sky on a falling star, trading altitude for speed and drifting through the wind in trails of light. It channels starlight, grows with every speck of stardust it gathers, and never sleeps: it anchors its soul to the stars instead. §8§oBut the earth never forgives those who leave it.
stlboy.journal.title: Aster's Journal
stlboy.journal.foot: Trials wait at shrines and Fallen Altars in the world: follow the pillar of light. Dying costs a tenth of the current bar.

stlboy.memory.ring.name: Memory of the Ring
stlboy.memory.ring.lore: You circled the world once, and the world remembered your orbit.
stlboy.memory.meteor.name: Memory of the Meteor
stlboy.memory.meteor.lore: Stone fell from the sky and you did not flinch.
stlboy.memory.meteor.fx: +20% knockback resistance, +1 cosmic damage on Constellations
stlboy.memory.constellation.name: Memory of the Constellations
stlboy.memory.constellation.lore: You drew a map in light. Now the dark cannot hide from you.
stlboy.memory.constellation.fx: Night Vision, +2 luck, +1 reach, immune to Darkness
stlboy.memory.motes.name: Memory of the Hunger
stlboy.memory.motes.lore: The stars are always hungry. So are you. Together you feed.
stlboy.memory.mirror.name: Memory of the Mirror
stlboy.memory.mirror.lore: You struck your own light back. Nothing hits you unchanged now.
stlboy.memory.echo.name: Memory of the Echo
stlboy.memory.echo.lore: You listened to the silence until it spoke. The dark has no hold on you.
stlboy.memory.horizon.name: Memory of the Horizon
stlboy.memory.horizon.lore: You stood at the edge of the well and chose to stay. Falling is a choice now.
stlboy.memory.wither.name: Memory of the Wither
stlboy.memory.wither.lore: Decay has a face. You wore it down.
stlboy.memory.wither.fx: +2 hearts, +1 cosmic damage on Constellations, immune to Wither
stlboy.memory.supernova.name: Memory of the Wormhole
stlboy.memory.supernova.lore: You burned once, brighter than the sky. Flame is kin now.
stlboy.memory.dragon.name: Memory of the Dragon
stlboy.memory.dragon.lore: The last sky-ruler fell. The sky is yours, and it knows.
stlboy.memory.dragon.fx: +3 hearts, +2 cosmic damage on Constellations, +1 reach
